AzureOpenAI.//: NO LONGER an availability floor. The embedding model is now per-user (chosen in Preferences — document RAG resolves its generator from the user's overlay, ADR 0007/0018), so EmbeddingDeploymentName is gone and nothing here is fatal-if-blank. Endpoint/ApiKey remain ONLY as the DORMANT Foundry-provider inheritance source (ProviderSettings.ResolveFoundry): baseline Models:Providers is empty (ADR 0019), so nothing reads them today; a user's Foundry provider declares its own endpoint + key. TenantId still binds DefaultAzureCredential for blob storage + ARM.
AzureOpenAI.//ApiKey: If ever set (for the dormant inheritance), it is a SECRET — never committed, arrives as AzureOpenAI__ApiKey. No longer required: the app boots with it blank/absent.

Models.//: Model providers (ADR 0013). A model is named by a QUALIFIED id, 'provider:model', split on the FIRST colon — GitHub's own ids contain a slash (openai/gpt-4o-mini), so a slash separator would have been ambiguous. An id with no colon is a legacy id and resolves against the default provider's namespace, which is why this needed no state migration.
Models.//Providers: EMPTY on purpose (ADR 0019): the app ships no baseline chat provider. Chat is entirely the per-user overlay (ADR 0018) — a signed-in user adds their own providers (Foundry, GitHub Models, Ollama, vLLM …) in Preferences, each declaring its own endpoint + key. A user with none configured gets an empty picker and a gated composer. Do NOT add a provider here to 'seed a default' — that would reinstate the operator default the ADR removed.
Models.//Default: Stays "" (ADR 0019). There is no operator default model; the effective default is resolved per-user from the overlay (a user's pinned default, else their first declared model, else "").

WebSearch.//: The SearXNG sidecar in the same Container App. Containers in one Container App share a network namespace, so it is reached over localhost; 8888 because the backend's own ingress already owns 8080. Overridden by WebSearch__Endpoint in Bicep and by the AppHost locally.

Geocoding.//: Reverse geocoding for the get_current_location tool (ADR 0012). GoogleApiKey is a SECRET and is never committed: it arrives as Geocoding__GoogleApiKey, from a Container App secret in prod (GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY GitHub secret) or user secrets locally. Absent is a supported state — the tool then reports coordinates with no street address, and the app starts normally.

ContextScrape.//ApiKey: SECRET for the hosted context.dev page-scrape API behind fetch_web_page (ADR 0027). Never committed: it arrives as ContextScrape__ApiKey, from a Container App secret in prod (CONTEXT_API_KEY GitHub secret) or user secrets locally. Absent is a supported state and NOT on the availability path — the app starts normally and fetch_web_page fails per call, telling the model the page could not be read (unlike SEARXNG_SECRET, whose absence is fatal). The base address is config-pinned in code (ContextWebPageFetcher.DefaultBaseAddress).

Hindsight.//ApiKey: SECRET for the Hindsight long-term-memory service (ADR 0056). Never committed: it arrives as Hindsight__ApiKey, from a Container App secret in prod (the HINDSIGHT_API_KEY GitHub secret) or user secrets locally. Absent is the DEFAULT and a supported state, and it is NOT on the availability path: the app starts normally and BuildAgent attaches no memory provider at all, so a turn makes ZERO Hindsight calls rather than calls that quietly fail (the GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY shape, not SEARXNG_SECRET's).
Hindsight.//Consequence: SETTING this key is the decision worth pausing on, because there is no Preferences toggle and no ToolCatalog key - not setting it is the ONLY off switch. Once set, EVERY non-incognito turn of EVERY conversation POSTs the user's message and the assistant's reply to a third party, and sends the user's message again as a recall query. That is broader than ADR 0013 (only when the user PICKS a third-party model) and ADR 0027 (only when the model CALLS fetch): it is automatic, always-on, and invisible in the UI. It carries whatever the conversation carries - document excerpts, the user's street address (ADR 0012), calendar content (ADR 0053). Incognito chats (ADR 0034) are excluded, and so are image-generation turns; reminder and agent-run turns are INCLUDED, and those run with no user present.
Hindsight.//Mission: Optional bank mission, used to create a user's bank on first use. Not a secret. With none set no create-bank call is ever made and the bank is assumed to exist.
Hindsight.//BaseAddress: Optional. Defaults to the Hindsight cloud (https://api.hindsight.vectorize.io); a self-hosted server is usually http://localhost:8888.

GoogleCalendar.//: The Google Calendar tools (ADR 0053), over a per-user OAuth connection made in Preferences → Calendar. ClientId and ClientSecret are BOTH SECRETS and are never committed: they arrive as GoogleCalendar__ClientId / GoogleCalendar__ClientSecret, from Container App secrets in prod (the GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID / GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET GitHub secrets) or user secrets locally. Both are needed together — Google's Web application client type is CONFIDENTIAL, so PKCE alone is not accepted on the token exchange. Absent is a supported state and NOT on the availability path: the app starts normally, GET /api/google/status reports configured:false, the UI offers no Connect button, and the six calendar tools return a curated 'not connected' notice per call. The section is deliberately named GoogleCalendar rather than Google, because Geocoding:GoogleApiKey already exists and two differently-scoped 'Google' keys one line apart is how an operator pastes the wrong secret. MANUAL PREREQ: see docs/integrations/google-calendar/README.md — in particular, the OAuth consent screen must be set to 'In production', or Google revokes every refresh token after 7 days.

Diagnostics.//: Budgets for the live OpenTelemetry console at /logs (ADR 0054) — a bounded in-memory ring, no datastore, no secret, lost on restart. Nothing here is a secret and nothing is on the availability path: the section may be absent entirely (it IS absent offline, since tools/Agent42.DevHost has no appsettings.json at all) and each key falls back to its own default. MaxBufferBytes is the one that matters: the chat client runs with EnableSensitiveData=true, so a gen_ai span carries gen_ai.input.messages — the whole conversation serialised to JSON, on EVERY turn — plus every tool and skill schema in gen_ai.tool.definitions. Bounding by item count alone is an out-of-memory bug in a 1 GiB container that also hosts the SearXNG sidecar, so the ring is bounded by bytes as well, split evenly between the span and log rings, and a single oversize value is truncated (and marked) on the way in. MaxItemsPerPoll caps the /api/diagnostics response, which is otherwise unbounded per poll; a caller-supplied limit may narrow it, never raise it.
Diagnostics.//Logging: NOTE the Logs tab looks empty in production and that is CORRECT: Logging:LogLevel:Default above is Warning, and ILogger category filtering runs BEFORE the OpenTelemetry logging processor, so Information/Debug records never reach the buffer and no value here can recover them. The tab reports the effective minimum level for exactly this reason. Do not 'fix' it by lowering the level here — that changes what the app ships to the OTLP collector too. Raise it deliberately with Logging__LogLevel__Default if you need the verbosity.

Push.//: Web Push notifications (ADR 0028) — a push titled with the agent's name when an agent replies on an async path (a fired reminder or an agent-run) while you're away. VapidPublicKey + VapidSubject are NOT secret and ARE committed here; the browser fetches the public key from GET /api/push/config. VapidPrivateKey is the ONLY secret: it arrives as Push__VapidPrivateKey, from a Container App secret in prod (VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY GitHub secret) or user secrets locally. Absent is a supported state and NOT on the availability path — the app starts, GET /api/push/config returns enabled:false, the UI hides the toggle, and no push is sent. MANUAL PREREQ: generate a P-256 VAPID keypair once (npx web-push generate-vapid-keys), paste the PUBLIC key below, and set the private key as the secret. Never rotate casually — a new private key invalidates every existing subscription.
